## Scope

Describe the focused change and the user problem it addresses.

## Linked issue

Link the issue, false positive, or rule request. Explain why no issue is needed
when applicable.

## Tests and results

List focused and full commands run, along with their results. State any skipped
checks and the exact reason.

## Public interface and report schema

Describe changes to CLI commands, configuration, diagnostics, public API, or
report schema. Write `None` when there is no public interface impact.

## Documentation and i18n

Confirm documentation and i18n/translation updates, including review of English
and Simplified Chinese content, or explain why none are needed.

## Security, privacy, dependencies, and licensing

Describe security or privacy effects. List dependency changes and licensing
implications, including any generated or bundled material.

## Checklist

- [ ] I followed the Code of Conduct and did not submit secrets or private data.
- [ ] I added or updated tests before implementation and recorded results.
- [ ] I updated relevant docs, i18n, rule YAML, fixtures, and generated rule docs.
- [ ] I used the private security route for vulnerabilities instead of a public issue or PR.
